lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's four liters? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 4 liters? Nope!

lines.text: Twenty liters, thirty percent juice. Ella adds juice and water.
lines.caption: 20 liters, 30% juice. Ella adds juice and water.

lines.text: Now it's twenty-five liters, forty percent juice. How much water did she add?
lines.caption: Now it's 25 liters, 40% juice. How much water did she add?

lines.text: The trick: split each drink into juice and water.
lines.caption: The trick: split each drink into juice and water.

lines.text: Thirty percent of twenty is six. So six juice, fourteen water.
lines.caption: 30% of 20 is 6. So 6 juice, 14 water.

lines.text: Forty percent of twenty-five is ten. So ten juice, fifteen water.
lines.caption: 40% of 25 is 10. So 10 juice, 15 water.

lines.text: Now watch only the water. Fourteen, then fifteen!
lines.caption: Now watch only the water. 14, then 15!

lines.text: So she adds just ONE liter of water!
lines.caption: So she adds just ONE liter of water!

lines.text: Four liters was the trap. That's the juice!
lines.caption: 4 liters was the trap. That's the juice!

lines.text: Did you get one liter? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 1 liter? Tell me below!
